### Lecture Content
```{r running the data}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(),
                     "../data/scout.db")
DBI::dbListTables(con)
postings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "scout_postings")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
dplyr::glimpse(postings[, c("title", "company",
  "location_state", "remote", "skills_json")])
```

#### SQL in R
```{r running SQL in r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(),
                     "../data/scout.db")
top_remote = DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT company, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM scout_postings
  WHERE remote = 1
  GROUP BY company
  ORDER BY n DESC
  LIMIT 10")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
top_remote
```
